* **Built against core 0.0.36**: requires
  `bankstatementparser >= 0.0.36`, the newest core release on PyPI.
* **A suite check that no longer trips on rate limits**: the suite
  consistency check authenticates its GitHub API request with the
  workflow token, so the shared anonymous limit no longer fails it.
* **In lockstep with the suite's 0.0.37 release**: all fourteen packages
  and bankstatementparser.com ship 0.0.37 together, with Python 3.15
  support in the core.
